evals.prompt: I just ran periplus map on my PHP project. What does the map lack, and what should I do about each gap?
evals.expected_output: A gap report from the shipped program, each gap read against its code and marked as a new rule, a new rutter or a site fault.
expectations: Runs periplus check-map before reading the map
Runs the shipped gap_read.py on .periplus/map.json from the project root
Does not paste or save a copy of the program in the project
Names a destination for each gap that needs a rule

evals.prompt: The report lists Suit::from under Site faults, and Suit is an enum. Is that a bug in the report? Should I write a rule for it?
evals.expected_output: The answer reads the enum declaration: a pure enum has no from, so the site is at fault and no rule is needed; a backed enum would not print there.
expectations: States that PHP builds from and tryFrom only into a backed enum
Opens the enum declaration at the file the map names
Says to fix the site and write no rule

evals.prompt: A method called on my class is missing from Site faults, and the class implements an interface from a vendor package. Why does it stay under the resolution gaps?
evals.expected_output: The answer explains that an interface outside the mapped code makes the chain unknown, so the name stays a resolution gap.
expectations: Names the chain of parents, traits and interfaces the program walks
States that an outside interface keeps the name a resolution gap
Does not call the name a site fault
